main_measure.name: in-state mean next-bar return minus all-bars mean
main_measure.threshold: difference <= -0.10% per day (-0.001) with stretch-clustered t <= -2

supporting_check.name: down-bar share in stretches minus share over all bars

decided_by: Inconclusive: the difference is negative but t > -2, or smaller than 0.10% per day, or the down-bar share in stretches is not higher than over all bars. (Info: strategy equity end 0.9423561551789104, holding over in-state bars end 0.6993358720075438.)
reading: In-state bars are bars with forecast < 0 and a next-bar return in the same window, stretches are contiguous runs of such bars per window (a run open at a window edge counts as a stretch), t is the difference divided by the cluster-robust (CR1) SE of the in-state mean over stretches treating the all-bars mean as fixed, and only the down-share comparison enters the confirm rule while the equity checks are reported for information.
